title.narrative: Joint Executive Program Project for the Establishment and Equipping of the Medical Diagnostic Center in Port Sudan

description.narrative: 1- Improving the quality of medical services provided 2- Diagnosing diseases at an early stage to help speed up recovery 3- Supporting the health sector infrastructure with modern medical devices and equipment

Rehabilitation of the diagnostic center at Port Sudan Teaching Hospital, purchase of a modern and advanced MRI device, furnishing the center with medical furniture and offices for medical staff, and training workers on the use of the MRI device in diagnosing medical cases. This device is considered a real addition to diagnostic services in the Red Sea State in general and the city of Port Sudan in particular.

The project will contribute to the diagnosis of many diseases, including: 1- Cerebral aneurysm. 2- Eye and inner ear diseases. 3- Multiple sclerosis. 4- Spinal cord diseases. 5- Stroke. 6- Tumors. 7- Traumatic brain injury. 8- Bone, ligament, joint and cartilage injuries
